answer: Require paid computing agents to post a bond exceeding the job fee and commit to an execution trace. During a dispute, challenger and worker bisect their traces until one machine step differs; a tiny on-chain interpreter checks it. A false step burns the bond and pays the challenger. An umber landscape above karst hides no shortcut: the trace supplies a checkable signal. Extra identities cannot make invalid work safe, since every simultaneous job needs separate collateral exposed to the same fraud proof.
